cases.name: ball joint scalar
cases.xml:
<mujoco>
  <option timestep="0.002" gravity="0 0 0" integrator="Euler"/>
  <worldbody>
    <body name="box" pos="0 0 1">
      <joint name="j" type="ball"/>
      <geom type="box" size="0.1 0.2 0.3" mass="1"/>
    </body>
  </worldbody>
  <actuator>
    <motor name="a" joint="j" gear="1.5"/>
  </actuator>
  <sensor>
    <actuatorpos actuator="a"/>
    <actuatorvel actuator="a"/>
  </sensor>
</mujoco>
